correctness.rationale: Standard q-Grassmann intersection parameters and adjacency eigenvalues determine the exact three distance eigenvalue rows by a transparent recurrence. Sector 1 has positive short-range coefficients and a dominating negative distance-three coefficient; sector 3 remains negative by an explicit derivative bound (or a cubic inequality at q=2); sector 2 has positive derivative, negative value at zero and positive value at one, so has a unique crossing. Double centering yields sharp Euclidean dimension. A first derivative expansion proves both asymptotic constants. The standalone checker independently enumerates all 1395 F_2 six-dimensional three-spaces and tests recurrence against exact formulas for 48 parameter pairs.

value.rationale: The q-Grassmann graph of three-spaces is a canonical homogeneous metric geometry for finite fields. Its exact critical conditional-negative-definiteness exponent, unique harmonic sector, sharp Euclidean embedding dimension jump and two simultaneous parameter asymptotics are mathematically motivated global invariants across two unrestricted parameter families, not an arbitrary finite census or mere renaming of general definitions.
